## Purpose

Checkpoint mode guarantees that all students can complete interpretation and reporting even if local FASTQ processing fails.

## Acceptable checkpoint inputs

- Count matrices and sample metadata.
- DESeq2 result tables.
- peak BED/narrowPeak files.
- bigWig tracks.
- QC reports.
- motif output.
- annotation files.

## Required documentation

Students must state which steps they ran directly, which outputs were checkpoint-provided, and which inputs and parameters would reproduce the full workflow.
